chapter: Fourteen years with Nat Cole and the recording sessions
title: Coleman Hawkins at Cafe Society Downtown
summary: After the army Collins worked with Hawkins, who drank all night and could play in any key, and recorded about thirty sides with him.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: But this was all during this era. Now, after, you know, I told you I went in the army and I stayed for about four years. Of course I did quite a bit of studying there. When I came out I recorded with Coleman Hawkins, and Peggy Lee, Sarah, Ella, Benny again, and there did some nice things. As a matter of fact I worked with Hawk at the Cafe Society Downtown, and which was a very good band, and he was an amazing musician. He was amazing man. He reminded me of a bull in that this man could drink, smoke pot, do everything all night long and you would never know that he had a drink. He was just -- the more he drank sometimes the better he would play.

And probably got off at 4:00 o'clock, he'd drive to Atlantic City. Oh, he was just almost indestructable. I think this contributed to his early death, also, because when he started going he just went, you know, just all at once. He was very quick.
Who else was in that band?

Well, Shadow Wilson was in the band and Billy Taylor was in the band. We had another -- we had a bass player by the name of Nelson Boyd. Hawk also liked to play in difficult keys. So we were going to play this tune Small Hotel, and Hawk said, well, he said, John let's play it

in A natural. Said fine. So Nelson Boyd said what key did you say we were going to play in, Hawk. Hawk, said, doesn't make any difference, Nelson, you're going to play the same notes, whatever key. Oh. But Hawk could play in all keys and he loved to do it. That was a great band.

I said that Billy Taylor was the pianist, right? Yeah. And who else was in there? Well, those were the important guys that you would know. And during that time I did quite a few recordings with Hawk. But some of them now escape me, but I know I did about 30 recordings with him during that period.
